query: UPDATE central.execution_ownership SET claimed_run_id = run_id, claimed_step_id = NULL, claimed_step_attempt_id = NULL, owner_scope = NULL, owner_identity = NULL, heartbeat_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND run_id = $2 AND lease_expires_at + interval '5 seconds' <= clock_timestamp()
